definitions.explanation: Indicates that something is done or changed to the fullest extent.

examples.japanese: すっかり{忘|わす}れていた。
{風邪|かぜ}がすっかり{治|なお}った。
{外|そと}はすっかり{暗|くら}くなった。
examples.english: It has gotten completely dark outside.

notes:
すっかり emphasizes completeness or thoroughness of a state or action.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- すっかり: completely (emphasis on thoroughness)
- {全部|ぜんぶ}: all, everything (quantity)
- {全然|ぜんぜん}: not at all (with negatives)
